note: These materials matter to US manufacturers and several faced export restrictions, but CMSEI does not score them yet. Scores are not made up: each one needs its USGS tables typed in twice by two people (docs/ADD-MATERIAL.md). Until then, parts that mention them are listed as 'not scored' so the gap is visible.

materials.name: Germanium
materials.why: China began licensing germanium exports on 1 Aug 2023, with gallium.

materials.name: Graphite
materials.why: Battery anodes depend on it. A Chinese export licensing rule was reported for graphite in late 2023; the source is not yet in the registry.

materials.name: Antimony
materials.why: A Chinese export rule on antimony was reported for 2024; the source is not yet in the registry.

materials.name: Tungsten
materials.why: China began licensing tungsten exports on 4 Feb 2025. Defense sourcing rules (DFARS) may also cover it: counsel should check before it is added to the compliance view.

materials.name: Tellurium
materials.why: China began licensing tellurium exports on 4 Feb 2025.
